ledger.artifactPolicy: Do not commit PNGs or bulky result dumps; keep only compact ledger records and replayable inputs.

PI-EXACT.assertion: Every slice and exact value survives in authored order; the total is finite and positive.

PI-ORDER.assertion: Legend entries retain input order and percentages are calculated from the exact total.

PI-LEGEND-FIT.assertion: Markers and percentage suffixes stay inside their legend columns; labels may ellipsize only when documented.

DONUT-EXACT.assertion: Every slice and exact value survives in authored order with percentages from the exact positive total.

DONUT-HOLE.assertion: Each slice is an annular arc with a transparent center, not a pie wedge to the origin.

DONUT-LEGEND-FIT.assertion: Legend markers, percentages, and columns do not overlap or clip.

BAR-SIGN.assertion: Negative bars extend left of zero and positive bars right of zero; row order is preserved.

BAR-ZERO.assertion: Zero has a visible baseline and a zero-width row remains identifiable.

BAR-LABEL.assertion: Signed value meaning remains readable; truncation never changes the exact summary.

LINE-ORDER.assertion: Strictly increasing x values retain proportional numeric or temporal spacing and input order.

LINE-GAP.assertion: A null y creates a disconnected gap and never creates a plotted point or marker.

LINE-MARKERS.assertion: Markers appear only when requested and only for finite y values.

LINE-FORMAT.assertion: Percent formatting changes labels only; source values and geometry remain fractional exact values.

SCATTER-POINTS.assertion: Every input row is a fixed-size dot, including duplicate coordinates.

SCATTER-ORDER.assertion: Point order and exact coordinates are retained; input is not sorted or aggregated.

SCATTER-LABELS.assertion: Every supplied point label is present and does not paint through another label or dot.

HIST-BINS.assertion: Equal-width boundaries use lower-inclusive/upper-exclusive bins except the final upper-inclusive bin; exact boundaries go right.

HIST-EMPTY.assertion: Empty bins remain as zero-count bars and all sample counts sum to the input length.

HIST-FINITE.assertion: All boundaries and bar geometry are finite, contiguous, and renderable.

BEZ-CUBIC.assertion: One exact M/C cubic path uses the supplied start, control1, control2, and end coordinates without sampled interpolation.

BEZ-CONTROLS.assertion: When requested, both control guides and control markers are visible without changing the cubic path.

BEZ-SQUARE.assertion: The plot is square with equal pixels-per-unit and contains all four points.

BEZ-FINITE.assertion: Coincident, straight, and extreme valid coordinates produce no NaN, Infinity, clipping, or missing endpoints.

HEAT-MATRIX.assertion: Rows and columns remain row-major, rectangular, and one positive-area cell per input cell.

HEAT-MISSING.assertion: null cells use the missing hatch and remain distinct from numeric zero in the summary.

HEAT-DOMAIN.assertion: Sequential uses observed min/max; diverging uses a symmetric zero-centered domain; nulls do not affect it.

HEAT-VALUES.assertion: Numeric values show only when requested and cells fit; exact values remain in summary/accessibility.

BOX-STATS.assertion: Type-7 quartiles, median, inclusive 1.5×IQR fences, and actual-sample whiskers are exact.

BOX-OUTLIERS.assertion: Outlier count and exact samples remain correct; duplicate outliers retain multiplicity in semantics.

BOX-HIDDEN-DOMAIN.assertion: showOutliers false hides dots only; all samples still determine the padded axis domain.

BOX-ORDER.assertion: Groups retain authored top-to-bottom order and labels do not overlap rows.

WATER-TOTALS.assertion: Start, every signed delta, every before/after total, and calculated final Total use unrounded input-order arithmetic.

WATER-DIRECTION.assertion: Increase/decrease bars and connectors show signed direction; the domain includes zero and every intermediate total.

WATER-ZERO.assertion: A zero change has a visible rule at its exact cumulative position.

DUMB-PAIRS.assertion: Each row has one independent before/after pair and one connector; rows are never cross-connected.

DUMB-DIFFERENCE.assertion: showDifferences displays signed after−before values, with percent mode as percentage points.

DUMB-EQUAL.assertion: Equal values share one position while the after dot remains visible inside the before ring.

DUMB-ORDER.assertion: Rows retain authored top-to-bottom order and the axis covers both series without forcing zero.

STACK-TOTALS.assertion: Each category total is the exact series-order sum and segment order matches the series order.

STACK-NORMALIZE.assertion: normalize true maps each nonzero category to 100%; zero totals stay zero and raw values remain unchanged.

STACK-ZERO.assertion: Zero segments have zero width but zero-valued series remain in the legend.

STACK-LEGEND.assertion: Each series has a separate, stable legend entry with no overlap.

GANTT-INTERVALS.assertion: Every task interval retains start/end and authored row order; no task is dropped.

GANTT-PROGRESS.assertion: Progress fills represent the exact 0..1 values; progress text may be omitted only when it cannot fit.

GANTT-DEPS.assertion: Every declared dependency points from prerequisite task to dependent task with an unambiguous arrow path.

GANTT-MILESTONES.assertion: Every milestone remains at its exact timeline coordinate with a visible diamond or exact summary.

GANTT-CAP.assertion: Height caps compact rows but retain every task, dependency, milestone, and exact summary.

NET-DIRECTION.assertion: Every directed edge has the declared source, target, and arrow direction; self-loops remain self-loops.

NET-SCC.assertion: Cycles, reciprocal edges, multiple parents, and disconnected nodes remain represented without force-layout nondeterminism.

NET-LABELS.assertion: Node identity and duplicate display labels remain distinguishable; exact labels and edge data remain accessible.

NET-CYCLE-LANES.assertion: Backward, same-layer, and self-loop paths use distinct readable lanes and do not cross node labels.

NET-CAP.assertion: A height cap retains every node and edge; only labels documented as too dense may be omitted visibly.

TREE-ROOT.assertion: Exactly one root and one connected acyclic hierarchy are retained.

TREE-PARENTS.assertion: Every non-root node has one link to its declared parent and no link paints through a label or node.

TREE-ORDER.assertion: Input order controls sibling order from top to bottom; broad levels remain distinguishable under compaction.

TREE-LABELS.assertion: Labels fit their available gaps or are explicitly omitted only when too crowded; exact IDs and labels stay accessible.

TREEMAP-SUMS.assertion: Parents and overall total equal exact child sums; leaf values and units are not silently converted.

TREEMAP-CONTAINMENT.assertion: Every child tile stays inside its parent and positive leaves receive area proportional to contribution.

TREEMAP-ZERO.assertion: Zero leaves and zero-valued top-level groups remain in exact summary/legend without consuming area.

TREEMAP-LABELS.assertion: Fitted labels stay inside their own tiles; small or skewed tiles may omit visible labels while full paths remain accessible.

visualizerPromptTemplate: Validate fixture {chart}/{caseId} using {tool}. Use the exact public JSON in {argsJson}; it excludes the internal type discriminator. For each natural profile in {profiles}, and each height-cap variant in {heightCaps}, render with cell dimensions 9x18, the named width, and theme {theme}. Do not shorten, aggregate, reorder, normalize, remove, or replace supplied data. First check the semantic invariants: {semanticInvariants}. Then inspect the actual rendered image at the target profile for clipping, overlap, legibility, contrast, misleading scales, ordering, connectors/arrows, legend correspondence, and the required visible information: {requiredVisible}. These omissions alone are allowed: {allowedOmissions}. Run objective checks {objectiveCheckIds} separately from the visual verdict. If incorrect, state the exact defect and corrected renderer revision, rerender the unchanged arguments, and inspect again; allow at most three attempts per view. Return one record per view with status validated or blocked, profile, theme, attempts, inspected artifact, defects corrected, and remaining limitations. A successful tool call or SVG/syntax inspection without an image is not validated.
